rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Rust port of the official JavaScript filesystem server that provides fast, safe file operations while maintaining protocol compatibility. Exposes comprehensive filesystem tools including read/write operations with head/tail support, directory management, file searching with glob patterns, regex-based content search (grep), and advanced editing capabilities like line-based surgical edits and bulk search/replace across multiple files. Features robust security with allowlist validation and symlink escape protection. Supports both stdio mode for local clients and HTTP streaming mode for remote access, making it valuable for development workflows, codebase refactoring, and automated file management tasks where performance and safety are priorities.
